latest_cos_commentary.headline: Sona is a well-funded (over $100M total) London-based AI workforce-management platform for hospitality and healthcare, with a named UK restaurant customer (Popeyes UK) and a recent $45M Series B in April 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's back_office line on labor scheduling/workforce management rather than POS or payments; UK/European-centric customer base to date based on sourced material.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Recently closed a large Series B (April 2026) explicitly to scale its AI workforce platform, indicating active, well-capitalized expansion, primarily reported in UK/European hospitality press so far.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where Sona is active in UK/European hospitality accounts, note it as a labor/workforce-scheduling specialist rather than a POS or payments competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Sourced customer evidence is limited to UK market references (Popeyes UK); no evidence found of US restaurant deployments in this pass.
